blocks.text: Filipino-Chinese model Randy See, who won the inaugural edition of Mr. Chinatown in 2013, died in a car accident in Manila, just five days before his 35th birthday. See’s death was confirmed by his partner, Ashelly, through a statement shared on her Instagram page last Saturday, Oct. 17. “In the early hours of this morning, Randy was involved in a car accident while driving alone in Manila. He has passed away,” a rough English translation of her statement in Chinese reads.
